name: net-net-clearance
prompt: Add a 0.25 mm power-to-ground clearance rule, source: skill example 0.25 mm above the substrate fabrication floor, then build, capture, and measure the realized copper. Also test a 0.05 mm request, source: skill test value 0.05 mm intentionally below the substrate fabrication floor, and record which value wins.

inputs.notes: The JLCPCB copper spacing floor is read from JLCPCBRules.min_copper_copper_space, jitxlib/jlcpcb/rules.py:9. The capture check excludes pours because captured Pour geometry is the input outline before runtime voiding.
inputs.environment: Commands run from the repository root with python3 resolving to the project interpreter that has jitx installed.

expected_output: A design module with module-scope power and ground tags, four structural board defaults, a priority 2 two-condition clearance rule, pad-to-point routes, and a below-floor variant. A check script submits and captures each design, verifies route realization and trace widths, measures power-to-ground non-pour copper clearance, and exits nonzero on failure. NOTES.md records the real commands, output, and the observed answer to the fabrication-floor question.

assertions.text: the pure helper unit tests pass
the shipped helper and reference module type-check against the installed JITX package
the built and captured reference checks pass
the 0.25 mm clearance value is labeled on its line as the skill example above the JLCPCB floor read from the substrate
NOTES.md records whether the 0.05 mm below-floor request or JLCPCBRules.min_copper_copper_space wins, and the statement matches captured copper
